## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is rebased on the latest `main`
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (`type(scope): subject`)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes for every affected package
- [ ] Tests added/updated and `npm test` is green (backend)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, or build artifacts staged
- [ ] README / `docs/` updated when public behavior changes
- [ ] `docs/SECURITY.md` updated for security-relevant changes
